query:
SELECT fa.id, fa.provisional_name, fa.zone, fa.precise_location, t.id as terroir_id, t.name as terroir_name 
FROM field_archives fa 
LEFT JOIN terroirs t ON fa.zone LIKE CONCAT('%', t.region, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', fa.zone, '%')
ORDER BY fa.id;
